A clear scope.
Before a commitment.

We start by understanding your business, the tools you use and the outcome you need. Then we agree on deliverables, responsibilities, integrations, costs and checkpoints.

Hosting, provider subscriptions, messaging accounts and ongoing support are discussed where they apply. No hidden assumption that everything is included.

Talk through your requirements

A few useful
answers.

Do we have to replace our existing tools?+

Not necessarily. We first check what you use and whether the tools support the connections you need.

What happens if a connection fails?+

We agree how failures are detected, reported and retried, including the manual fallback your team will use.

Can every task be automated?+

No. We identify the useful repeatable steps and keep human judgement or approval where it is needed.
